summary: Preserved candidate 12421813's Python OpenAI serving validation, corrected its error.param contract to null, and added explicit model membership validation to the model-gateway IGW HTTP resolution path with focused boundary regressions.

tests.what_was_measured: The candidate's valid Python model validation behavior: 4 tests and 2 subtests passed before the correction tests were tightened.

tests.command: cargo test --manifest-path sgl-model-gateway/Cargo.toml router_manager::tests --no-fail-fast (candidate with gateway regression, before correction)
tests.what_was_measured: The prepared image has no cargo executable. Direct candidate source inspection independently confirmed that resolve_model_id returned every explicit model before reading the registry; the new regression also references the correction-only helper and therefore is absent from the candidate.
404 model_not_found response contract with param=null, served and omitted model acceptance, explicit default rejection, and registered/unregistered LoRA boundaries: 4 tests and 2 subtests passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: This correction targets deterministic request validation before engine execution. Candidate PR 2315's retained tiny-Llama evidence was preserved, but no new GPU execution was claimed for this correction.

remaining_limitations: The prepared image contains no cargo or rustfmt executable, so the Rust model-gateway regression could not be compiled or executed locally.
No production model weights, alternate model architecture, semantic-accuracy, distributed, or multi-node behavior was tested; none is required to establish these pre-execution validation defects.
